decisions.reclaimed_water_plan: Allocate 1,800 liters of reclaimed water to Line Y's scheduled batch. Line X will not receive reclaimed water due to conductivity exceeding its process limit. Before delivery: (1) Ravi must upload the 1,800 µS/cm conductivity test result to the shared quality folder; (2) the recovery skid must undergo a 3-hour membrane flush before any reclaimed water is delivered; (3) sanitizer level must be verified and adjusted to exactly 0.3 ppm with a signed sanitizer log for each day of use. After the flush, the skid will deliver at 600 liters per hour, requiring 3 hours to supply the full 1,800 liters — a minimum of 6 hours total from start of flush to full delivery. The remaining 600 liters in the reclaimed tank will be held as reserve.
